storyBible.worldAnchor: A Chinese rural fable setting, warm picture book illustration style, consistent characters and locations across scenes.

characters.name: Red Riding Hood
characters.anchorPrompt: A young girl wearing a red hooded cape, simple village dress, standing in a forest path, with a basket.

characters.name: Grandmother
characters.anchorPrompt: An elderly woman in a simple dress, sitting in a cottage, with a shawl.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.anchorPrompt: A sly wolf with gray fur, standing near a path, eyes gleaming.

characters.name: Hunter
characters.anchorPrompt: A rugged hunter in a forest coat, carrying a bow.

props.name: Basket
props.anchorPrompt: A woven wicker basket, medium size, open, with a cloth lining, resting on a path.

props.name: Apple
props.anchorPrompt: A bright red apple, ripe, on a wooden table.

locations.name: Forest
locations.anchorPrompt: A dense forest with tall trees, dappled sunlight filtering through leaves, a winding path.

locations.name: Cottage
locations.anchorPrompt: A modest wooden cottage with a thatched roof, smoke curling from the chimney, a small garden.

locations.name: Village
locations.anchorPrompt: A quiet rural village with stone houses, cobblestone streets, and a central square.

eventChain: Red Riding Hood sets out on the forest path
Red Riding Hood realizes the choice will change everyone's fate
Red Riding Hood investigates the anomaly and encounters the wolf
Red Riding Hood protects her grandmother at the cottage
Red Riding Hood breaks the cycle and walks into a new dawn
Red Riding Hood keeps the secret, maintaining the status quo
